da — Design Authority CLI. Same library the MCP server exposes. da overview |
search Q | discover Q | inspect ID | resolve PROBLEM | validate TARGET da
golden | gaps | gap-add | propose `discover` and `resolve --assist semantic`
are optional retrieval extensions (install extras: pip install fastembed
numpy; build the index once with tools/da_sem.py build). Retrieval only
proposes; it never establishes authority. Without the extras every lexical
surface is unchanged.
